title: Animals, Colors and Music
author: The Quartets of You project
description: Three sample puzzles that use every field in the format. Copy one and make it your own.

puzzles.title: Animal Kingdom
puzzles.subtitle: Not every animal here is what it seems.
puzzles.winMessage: The whole menagerie, sorted. Well done!

groups.name: Names for animal groups
groups.details: A pride of lions, a herd of cattle, a flock of sheep and a pod of whales.

groups.name: Things that bark
groups.details: Seals and foxes bark too. A tree's bark is a different word that happens to sound the same.

groups.name: ___fly
groups.details: Butterfly, dragonfly, firefly and horsefly. Dragon and Horse were the decoys.

puzzles.title: Color Wheel
puzzles.subtitle: Some of these colors lead double lives.

groups.name: ___print
groups.details: Blueprint, fingerprint, footprint and newsprint. Blue is in the rainbow too, but only Blue makes a print.

groups.name: Colors that are also first names
groups.details: Violet and Olive are names as well, which is what makes this one tricky.

puzzles.title: Music Room
puzzles.subtitle: Five wrong notes allowed in this one.

groups.name: Choir voices
groups.details: The same four voices that name the quartets in this game.

groups.name: Things that can be flat
groups.details: A flat tire, flat feet, flat soda and a flat battery. In music, a note can be flat too.

groups.name: ___ band
groups.details: A rubber band, a boy band, a brass band and a wristband. Brass could pass for an instrument family.
